title: Reading Like a Teacher: Discovering Possibilities of Mentor Texts
summary: What makes a text a mentor text? This interactive, one-hour workshop will explore how texts can serve as models for students’ reading, writing, and meaning making. Together, we’ll consider what makes an effective mentor text, then examine texts of our own to uncover possibilities for classroom use. Bring a text you’re curious about using with your students.
